name: Greater Channel Spirit
body:
You reached an even greater connection with the spirit within you.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Channel Spirit, Improved Channel Spirit, Spirit Ridden, character level 13th.

Benefit(s): You gain either the intermediate or greater power (your choice) granted by the spirit you selected with the Improved Channel Spirit feat. For purposes of using that power, treat your medium level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in medium. You do not gain any other medium abilities.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you select the feat, it applies to a different spirit power for that spirit available at medium level 6 or 11.
